card.name: "the" or "during" before time-course terms
card.fires_on: The small words "the" or "during" right before a time-related noun such as "acute stage" or "half-life". Seen in HIV test warnings and NSAID-digoxin interaction text.

modes.label: during/the before acute
modes.description: "during" or "the" in the phrase about HIV-1 not being identified during the acute stage of infection.
modes.example: Some HIV-1 tests only detect anti-HIV antibodies and may not identify HIV-1<< during>> the acute stage of infection.

modes.label: the before half-life
modes.description: "the" after "prolong" in the digoxin interaction sentence, just before "half-life".
modes.example: The concomitant use of ibuprofen with digoxin has been reported to increase the serum concentration and prolong<< the>> half-life of digoxin.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mixed and unclear, though some (chron, chronic) hint at time-course words coming next.
